questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the decision of the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee at its 5 to 7 October 2026 meeting, consider the following statements:
1. The repo rate was raised by 50 basis points to 5.75%.
2. The stance was changed to calibrated tightening.
3. The decision cited inflation near 5.8%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The MPC raised the repo rate by 25 basis points, from 5.25% to 5.50%, and changed the stance to calibrated tightening. A higher repo rate makes bank loans costlier and cools demand and prices.
questions.insight: A higher repo rate makes bank loans costlier and cools demand and prices.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With the repo rate at 5.50%, consider the following statements about the RBI's rate corridor:
1. The Marginal Standing Facility rate is 5.75%.
2. The Standing Deposit Facility rate is 5.50%, the same as the repo rate.
3. The Standing Deposit Facility rate is the floor of the corridor.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The corridor is repo plus 25 basis points (MSF and Bank Rate) and repo minus 25 basis points (SDF), so MSF is 5.75% and SDF is 5.25%. The SDF lets the RBI absorb surplus liquidity without giving collateral.
questions.insight: SDF is the floor of the corridor: it lets the RBI absorb surplus liquidity without giving collateral.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, consider the following statements:
1. It honoured work on light-gated ion channels.
2. Hegemann and Nagel found channelrhodopsin in an alga.
3. The work led to the development of CRISPR genome editing.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were honoured for work that led to optogenetics: Deisseroth used channelrhodopsin to switch neurons on and off in living animals. It did not lead to CRISPR.
questions.insight: Channelrhodopsin is a light-sensitive protein, a common Prelims keyword for this topic.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences, awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, recognised which one of the following?
opts: Their study of how political and economic institutions shape national prosperity
Their research on auction theory and the design of new auction formats
Their analysis of labour markets, minimum wages and immigration effects
Their work on the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation
questions.why: The Academy recognised their work building macroeconomic models on microeconomic foundations. Central banks and governments use such models to counter shocks, so policy tools are tested in them.
questions.insight: Link it to monetary policy questions: the policy tools are tested in such models.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory, honoured in the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics, is located at the South Pole.
Statement-II: IceCube uses light sensors buried in a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice to spot high-energy neutrinos from space.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Both are correct, but the second describes how the detector works and does not explain why it is at the South Pole. India's own neutrino project, INO, has been proposed at Theni in Tamil Nadu.
questions.insight: India's own neutrino project, INO, has been proposed at Theni in Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.syllabus: Chemistry in everyday life; recent awards
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai, is related to which one of the following puzzles?
opts: How the long chains of amino acids in proteins fold themselves into their final working shapes
How lithium-ion batteries can be built to hold their charge for much longer periods of use in devices
How ozone is broken down in the stratosphere by chlorine compounds from refrigerants and aerosols
How one mirror-image form of a molecule, as in amino acids, comes to dominate
questions.why: Their work on non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric synthesis showed how one mirror-image form (homochirality) can win out and be made on purpose. Mirror-image forms of a drug can act very differently, so this matters for medicines.
questions.insight: Mirror-image forms of a drug can act very differently, so this matters for medicines.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the Global Hunger Index 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India ranks 100th among 122 countries.
2. India's score of 24.1 falls in the 'serious' category.
3. The index is scored out of 100, and a higher score means less hunger.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: A higher score means worse hunger. India's 24.1 is above the South Asia score of 23.5 and the world score of 18.1. Child wasting at 19.0% is the highest rate in South Asia.
questions.insight: Child wasting at 19.0% is the highest rate in South Asia, so a question on the weakest indicator is likely.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
Consider the following:
1. Undernourishment
2. Child stunting
3. Adult literacy rate
4. Child mortality
How many of the above are indicators used to calculate the Global Hunger Index?
questions.why: The four indicators are undernourishment, child stunting, child wasting and child mortality. Literacy is not included. A higher score means worse hunger.
questions.insight: Remember GHI as a score out of 100: higher means worse hunger.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
Consider the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) decision of 14 October 2026:
1. It was continued for five years, 2026-27 to 2030-31, and renamed Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana.
2. The disability benchmark for the disability pension was lowered from 80% to 40%.
3. The minimum age for the disability pension was raised to 18 years.
Which of the above are correct?
questions.why: The programme was continued with about Rs 53,428 crore, and the disability benchmark was lowered to 40%. The age condition was removed, so eligibility starts from birth, not raised to 18.
questions.insight: NSAP gives effect to the Directive Principle in Article 41 (public assistance in old age, sickness and disablement).

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
Consider the government's approval of the strategic restructuring (sale) of IDBI Bank on 14 October 2026:
1. The sale covers 60.72% of the bank.
2. The stake is split between the Government of India (30.48%) and LIC (30.24%).
3. The buyer must still pass the RBI's fit-and-proper assessment.
Which of the above are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct per the PIB release. The government and LIC keep 15% and 19% respectively after the sale.
questions.insight: IDBI Bank was re-categorised as a private sector bank by the RBI in 2019 after LIC took a controlling stake.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to Ramsar Sites in India, as per the Government of India's note of 25 October 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India has 103 Ramsar Sites.
2. The number has risen from 26 in 2014.
3. Ramsar designation creates a separate Indian law for each site.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Ramsar designation recognises a site's international importance and 'wise use'. It does not by itself create a separate Indian law for the site.
questions.insight: Ramsar designation recognises international importance and 'wise use'; it does not by itself create a separate Indian law for the site.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana, approved on 28 October 2026, is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, so its cost is shared by the Centre and the States.
Statement-II: Panchayats are provided for in Part IX of the Constitution, added by the 73rd Amendment.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Both are correct, but Part IX does not explain why the scheme is Centrally Sponsored. The outlay is about Rs 7,395.55 crore: about Rs 4,869.48 crore from the Centre and Rs 2,526.07 crore from the States. It covers over 2.55 lakh Panchayats and traditional local bodies.
questions.insight: Panchayats come under Part IX of the Constitution (Articles 243 to 243O), added by the 73rd Amendment.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
Consider the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (approved 28 October 2026):
1. Its cost is shared between the Centre and the States.
2. It also covers traditional rural local institutions in areas where Part IX does not apply.
3. It is a Central Sector Scheme funded entirely by the Centre.
Which of the above are correct?
questions.why: The scheme is Centrally Sponsored, so costs are shared (Centre about Rs 4,869 crore, States about Rs 2,526 crore). Statement 3 is wrong.
questions.insight: Part IX does not apply to Scheduled Areas and tribal areas (Article 243M); PESA 1996 extends Panchayats there.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the Cabinet decision of 28 October 2026 on Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR), consider the following statements:
1. DA and DR rise by 3 percentage points over the existing 60%.
2. The increase takes effect from 1 January 2027.
3. It benefits about 48.54 lakh employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The increase is effective 1 July 2026, not 1 January 2027, and costs about Rs 10,016 crore a year. DA offsets inflation for serving employees, and Dearness Relief is the same relief for pensioners.
questions.insight: DA offsets inflation for serving employees; Dearness Relief is the same relief for pensioners.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: A reshuffle of several State Governors was announced on 12 October 2026. With reference to the appointment of a Governor, which one of the following is correct?
opts: Parliament elects the Governor by a resolution passed in both Houses of Parliament
The Prime Minister appoints the Governor on the advice of the Election Commission
The Chief Minister appoints the Governor with the concurrence of the High Court's Chief Justice
The President appoints the Governor by a warrant under hand and seal
questions.why: Article 155 provides for appointment by the President by warrant under hand and seal. The Governor holds office during the pleasure of the President (Article 156). The normal term is five years, but the Governor continues until a successor takes charge.
questions.insight: The normal term is five years, but the Governor continues until a successor takes charge.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: The Election Commission has completed the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in 20 States and Union Territories. The Commission's power to supervise, direct and control the preparation of electoral rolls comes from which one of the following?
questions.why: Article 324 vests superintendence, direction and control of the preparation of electoral rolls and the conduct of elections in the Commission. Article 326 gives universal adult suffrage at 18 years, and Article 329 bars courts from interfering in electoral matters.
questions.insight: Article 326 gives universal adult suffrage (18 years); Article 329 bars courts from interfering in electoral matters.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to by-elections to fill a casual vacancy in Parliament or a State Legislature, consider the following statements:
1. A by-election must be held within three months of the vacancy.
2. Section 151A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 requires it to be held within six months.
3. The Election Commission decides the date of the by-election.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Section 151A requires a by-election within six months, unless the remainder of the term is under one year. The Nagaon (Assam) Lok Sabha by-election was held on 6 October 2026, with counting on 9 October.
questions.insight: The Election Commission, not the Government, decides the date of by-elections.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi (26-27 October 2026) was opened by the Lok Sabha Speaker. Consider the following statements about the Speaker of the Lok Sabha:
1. The Speaker is elected by the members of the Lok Sabha from among themselves.
2. The Speaker presides over a joint sitting of the two Houses.
3. The Speaker decides whether a bill is a Money Bill.
4. The Speaker is appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: Article 93 provides for the Lok Sabha to choose its Speaker and Deputy Speaker from among its members, so the statement on appointment by the President is wrong. The Speaker presides over joint sittings and certifies Money Bills.
questions.insight: The Speaker presides over joint sittings and decides whether a bill is a Money Bill.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the Consumer Price Index (base 2024=100) released by MoSPI on 12 October 2026 for September 2026, consider the following statements:
1. All-India CPI inflation was 5.54% (provisional).
2. Rural inflation was 6.08% and urban inflation 4.88%.
3. Urban inflation was higher than rural inflation.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: Food inflation on the Consumer Food Price Index was 7.74%. CPI is compiled by the National Statistics Office under MoSPI.
questions.insight: CPI is compiled by the National Statistics Office under MoSPI. The new series uses 2024 as the base year.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: CPI inflation of 5.54% in September 2026 lies inside the tolerance band of the RBI's flexible inflation targeting framework.
Statement-II: The framework sets a target of 4% with a tolerance band of 2 percentage points on either side.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: The band is 2% to 6%, so 5.54% is inside the band but above the 4% target. The MPC has six members, and the RBI Governor has a casting vote in a tie.
questions.insight: The MPC has six members; the RBI Governor has a casting vote in a tie.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the rabi Minimum Support Prices for the 2027-28 marketing season, approved on 30 September 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The wheat MSP was fixed at Rs 2,610 per quintal, up Rs 25.
2. Rapeseed and mustard got the largest increase among the crops.
3. Safflower got the largest increase, Rs 675 per quintal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Safflower got the largest rise (Rs 675), then rapeseed and mustard (Rs 413). The Government cites a margin of about 106% over cost for wheat.
questions.insight: Production cost and expected margin: the Government cites a margin of about 106% over cost for wheat.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: With reference to Minimum Support Prices (MSP) in India, which one of the following statements is correct?
opts: The Finance Commission fixes them for each State according to the cost in the State
The Food Corporation of India recommends them and the NITI Aayog approves them every year
The Reserve Bank of India recommends them in its bi-monthly monetary policy statement
The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices recommends them for 22 mandated crops
questions.why: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approves the MSPs. Sugarcane has a Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP), not an MSP.
questions.insight: Sugarcane has a Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP), not an MSP.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the SME Growth Fund for which the Cabinet approved a Government commitment of Rs 10,000 crore in October 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The money is to be invested as equity in growth-stage Small and Medium Enterprises.
2. The fund is set up as an Alternative Investment Fund.
3. The fund gives interest-free loans to micro enterprises in rural areas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The fund fills a gap in long-term equity for growth-stage SMEs, with a focus on manufacturing and industrial clusters in Tier II and III cities. AIFs are regulated by SEBI, and the money is risk capital, not loans.
questions.insight: AIFs are regulated by SEBI; SME Growth Fund money is meant as risk capital, not loans.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme, approved on 28 October 2026 with an outlay of Rs 10,000 crore up to FY 2039-40, supports Indian container manufacturers through interest subvention and operating cost assistance.
Statement-II: Under interest subvention the Government pays part of the interest, so the borrower pays less.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Both are correct, but the definition of interest subvention does not explain why the scheme was introduced; the scheme aims to build domestic container manufacturing. Operating expenditure assistance is about Rs 8,891 crore.
questions.insight: Interest subvention means the Government pays part of the interest so the borrower pays less.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme, approved on 28 October 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The outlay is about Rs 1,856.67 crore for FY 2026-27 to FY 2033-34.
2. About Rs 1,130 crore is for attracting investment.
3. About Rs 105 crore is for international federation certification.
4. The Union Budget 2026-27 had earmarked Rs 5,000 crore for sports goods manufacturing.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: The Union Budget 2026-27 had earmarked Rs 500 crore for sports goods manufacturing, not Rs 5,000 crore. The scheme builds a competitive manufacturing base.
questions.insight: The Union Budget 2026-27 had earmarked Rs 500 crore for sports goods manufacturing.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: The 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity, held from 19 to 30 October 2026, took place in which one of the following cities?
questions.why: COP15 (Kunming-Montreal) adopted the Global Biodiversity Framework, whose '30 by 30' target aims to protect 30% of land and sea by 2030.
questions.insight: The Framework's '30 by 30' target aims to protect 30% of land and sea by 2030.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to the UN Climate Change Conference COP31, consider the following statements:
1. It is scheduled to be held in Dubai.
2. Türkiye is the host, with Murat Kurum as COP31 President.
3. Australia's Chris Bowen is President of Negotiations.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: COP31 is scheduled for 9 to 20 November 2026 in Antalya, Türkiye. COP30 was held in Belem, Brazil, in 2025.
questions.insight: COP30 was held in Belem, Brazil, in 2025.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to the Green Energy Corridor Phase-III, approved on 30 September 2026 with an outlay of Rs 1,86,405 crore, consider the following statements:
1. It strengthens State grids to carry up to 135 GW of renewable power.
2. It focuses only on pumped hydro storage in the Himalayas.
3. It adds 50 GWh of battery energy storage.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The scheme is mainly for intra-State transmission, carried out by State Transmission Utilities, along with 50 GWh of battery storage. Battery storage helps manage the intermittency of solar and wind.
questions.insight: Battery storage helps manage the intermittency of solar and wind.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to India's renewable energy capacity, as per PIB figures for 31 July 2026, consider the following statements:
1. Installed solar capacity was about 164.59 GW.
2. Non-fossil capacity was about 300.50 GW.
3. Non-fossil capacity was over 54% of total installed capacity.
4. India ranks first in the world in renewable capacity, according to IRENA.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: India ranks third globally in renewable capacity according to IRENA statistics, not first.
questions.insight: India ranks third globally in renewable capacity according to IRENA statistics.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The GOBARdhan Scheme, launched on 1 October 2026, is a Central Sector Scheme to develop the Compressed Biogas sector.
Statement-II: The scheme has an outlay of Rs 23,731 crore for FY 2026-27 to 2035-36.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Both are correct, but the size of the outlay does not explain why the scheme was set up. It offers assured offtake, a pricing framework and capital assistance. GOBARdhan stands for Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan.
questions.insight: GOBARdhan stands for Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Which one of the following schemes, launched on 1 October 2018, created a market for Compressed Biogas as an alternative green transport fuel?
opts: PM-KUSUM, the scheme to solarise agricultural pumps and farm feeders
UJALA, the programme to distribute LED bulbs at lower prices to households
FAME India, the scheme to promote the adoption of electric and hybrid vehicles
questions.why: SATAT set up CBG plants and a market for them, and the new GOBARdhan scheme builds on it with guaranteed offtake and pricing. CBG is a purified form of biogas, mainly methane, that can replace CNG.
questions.insight: CBG is a purified form of biogas, mainly methane, that can replace CNG.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to India's Seventh National Report to the Convention on Biological Diversity (2026), consider the following statements:
1. India has 58 Tiger Reserves.
2. India has 33 Elephant Reserves.
3. The 2022 tiger estimate was 2,967.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The 2022 tiger estimate was 3,682, up from 2,967 in 2018. India also has 18 Biosphere Reserves, 106 National Parks and 574 Wildlife Sanctuaries. Tiger reserves are notified by States on the advice of the NTCA.
questions.insight: The 2022 tiger estimate was 3,682, up from 2,967 in 2018. Tiger reserves are notified by States on NTCA advice.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q: DRDO flew a High-Altitude Platform (HAPS) in October 2026, which reached about 21 km and hovered near 20 km for over 30 minutes. This altitude lies in which one of the following layers of the atmosphere?
questions.why: The stratosphere lies from about 12 to 50 km. Such platforms sit between aircraft and satellites, so they are called pseudo-satellites, and they fly there for long-endurance surveillance and communication.
questions.insight: Because they sit between aircraft and satellites, such platforms are called pseudo-satellites.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to SEMICON India 2026, held from 17 to 19 September 2026, consider the following statements:
1. It announced Semicon 2.0, which raises the India Semiconductor Mission's budget from USD 8 billion to about USD 13.5 billion.
2. The Prime Minister inaugurated the event.
3. Semicon 2.0 extends support to design, manufacturing, packaging, research and talent.
4. The India Semiconductor Mission works under the Department of Science and Technology.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: The India Semiconductor Mission works under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), not the Department of Science and Technology.
questions.insight: The India Semiconductor Mission works under MeitY.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the IndiaAI Mission, consider the following statements:
1. It was approved by the Union Cabinet in March 2019.
2. It has an outlay of about Rs 10,372 crore over five years.
3. The Government said at the AI Impact Summit 2026 that it would add 20,000 GPUs to the 38,000 already available.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The Union Cabinet approved the Mission in March 2024, with an outlay of Rs 10,371.92 crore. A GPU is a graphics processing unit, the chip type used to train AI models.
questions.insight: A GPU is a graphics processing unit, the chip type used to train AI models.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath, consider the following statements:
1. It was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2026 as India's 45th property.
2. The decision was taken at the World Heritage Committee meeting in Busan.
3. The Maratha Military Landscapes was India's 45th property, inscribed in 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The Maratha Military Landscapes was the 44th property, inscribed in 2025; Sarnath became the 45th in July 2026. At Sarnath the Buddha gave his first sermon, the Dhammachakkapravartana.
questions.insight: At Sarnath the Buddha gave his first sermon, the Dhammachakkapravartana.

questions.subject: History
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas is observed on 31 October, the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
Statement-II: Sardar Patel is remembered for integrating the princely states into India.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Patel was born on 31 October 1875, and he was India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister. The Statue of Unity stands at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat.
questions.insight: He was India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: The Ministry of Culture signed an MoU with the Bibliotheque nationale de France on 26 October 2026 under the Gyan Bharatam Mission. What is its purpose?
opts: Restoring the monuments of the Gupta period that stand in northern India today
Returning the stolen antiquities that were taken out of India during the colonial period
Creating a joint museum of Indian art in the French capital city of Paris
Digitisation and conservation of India's manuscript heritage
questions.why: The Gyan Bharatam Mission works to survey, conserve and digitise Indic manuscripts, and the MoU covers Indic-origin manuscripts held in France. Digital access is a key way of preserving fragile palm-leaf and paper manuscripts.
questions.insight: Digital access is a key way of preserving fragile palm-leaf and paper manuscripts.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar, consider the following statements:
1. It is given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
2. It is given to young artists.
3. Bismillah Khan was a sitar maestro.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Bismillah Khan was a shehnai maestro and a Bharat Ratna awardee. The Sangeet Natak Akademi is the national academy of music, dance and drama.
questions.insight: Bismillah Khan was a shehnai maestro and a Bharat Ratna awardee.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the BRICS Theatre Festival 2026, held under India's BRICS presidency, consider the following statements:
1. It was held from 12 to 14 October in New Delhi.
2. The Ministry of Culture organised it.
3. The National School of Drama was the nodal agency.
4. The Lalit Kala Akademi was the nodal agency.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: The festival brought together over 100 theatre practitioners. India holds the BRICS chair in 2026.
questions.insight: India holds the BRICS chair in 2026.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q:
With reference to the southwest monsoon withdrawal and the northeast monsoon in October 2026, consider the following statements:
1. IMD declared the southwest monsoon fully withdrawn from the country on 15 October 2026.
2. On the same day, the northeast monsoon set in over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, coastal Andhra Pradesh and Kerala.
3. The northeast monsoon sets in over Punjab, Haryana and Delhi.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The northeast monsoon sets in over the south-eastern coast. Tamil Nadu gets most of its rain from this retreating monsoon, from October to December.
questions.insight: Tamil Nadu gets most of its rain from the northeast (retreating) monsoon, from October to December.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Tamil Nadu receives most of its annual rainfall in the months of October to December.
Statement-II: In the retreating or northeast monsoon season, moist winds over the Bay of Bengal and cyclonic systems bring heavy rain to the Coromandel Coast.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Western disturbances bring winter rain to the north-west, not to Tamil Nadu. The Himalayas do not block the monsoon winds that reach the south.
questions.insight: Western disturbances bring winter rain to the north-west, not to Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q:
With reference to cyclones in the North Indian Ocean, consider the following statements:
1. There are two cyclone seasons: April to June and October to December.
2. The Bay of Bengal is more active than the Arabian Sea.
3. Strong vertical wind shear during the southwest monsoon encourages cyclone formation.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: Strong vertical wind shear discourages cyclone formation during the southwest monsoon. IMD reported a low-pressure area in the Arabian Sea on 18 October 2026 and expected another over the Bay of Bengal near 23 October.
questions.insight: During the southwest monsoon, strong vertical wind shear discourages cyclone formation.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: Sukhna Wetland, one of the newer entries in India's Ramsar list of 103 sites as of October 2026, lies near which one of the following cities?
questions.why: Sukhna is a reservoir at the foot of the Shivalik hills, fed by seasonal streams. Sauj Jheel, also added, is in Uttar Pradesh.
questions.insight: Sauj Jheel, also added, is in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q:
With reference to the South Pole, consider the following statements:
1. The geographic South Pole lies on the Antarctic continent, under thick ice.
2. The Indian research stations in Antarctica are Maitri and Himadri.
3. The IceCube observatory, honoured in the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics, is located at the South Pole.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: India's research stations in Antarctica are Maitri and Bharati. Himadri is India's research station in the Arctic.
questions.insight: The Indian research stations in Antarctica are Maitri and Bharati.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Armenia, the host of the CBD COP17, is a landlocked country in the South Caucasus.
Statement-II: Armenia borders Georgia, Azerbaijan, Iran and Turkiye.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Both are correct, but the list of neighbours does not explain the fact that it is landlocked. Its capital, Yerevan, hosted COP17 from 19 to 30 October 2026.
questions.insight: Its capital, Yerevan, hosted COP17 from 19 to 30 October 2026.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the India-Poland joint statement issued during the visit of the Polish Prime Minister (21 to 23 October 2026), consider the following statements:
1. The two sides set a target of tripling defence exports by 2028.
2. The two sides agreed on joint research on artificial intelligence, semiconductors and quantum technology.
3. The two sides set a target of doubling bilateral trade by 2030.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The two sides set a target of doubling bilateral trade by 2030, not tripling defence exports. They also expected a classified-information protection agreement to be signed soon. India and Poland set up a Strategic Partnership in 2024, with an Action Plan for 2024 to 2028.
questions.insight: India and Poland set up a Strategic Partnership in 2024 with an Action Plan for 2024 to 2028.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q: India invited Poland to join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI). At which one of the following was the IPOI announced by India's Prime Minister?
opts: The United Nations General Assembly in New York in 2015
The G20 Summit in Osaka in 2019 during the Japanese presidency
The BRICS Summit in Johannesburg in 2023 during the year
The East Asia Summit in Bangkok in 2019
questions.why: India announced IPOI at the East Asia Summit in November 2019 as an open, global initiative for a safe and secure maritime domain.
questions.insight: Poland also said it would join the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI).

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Poland announced that it will join the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI), which India launched at the UN Climate Action Summit in 2019.
Statement-II: The secretariat of the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure is in New Delhi.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
opts: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct, but Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct, but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect, but Statement-II is correct
questions.why: Both are correct, but the location of the secretariat does not explain Poland's decision to join. CDRI promotes resilient infrastructure so that countries can cope with disasters and climate risks.
questions.insight: CDRI promotes resilient infrastructure, helping countries cope with disasters and climate risks.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum held in New Delhi on 26 and 27 October 2026, consider the following statements:
1. India holds the BRICS presidency in 2026.
2. BRICS originally stood for Brazil, Russia, India and China, and South Africa joined in 2010.
3. The Forum is held every year in Johannesburg.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The Parliamentary Forum and a Theatre Festival were part of India's programme as chair, so the Forum was held in New Delhi, not Johannesburg.
questions.insight: BRICS originally stood for Brazil, Russia, India and China, with South Africa joining in 2010.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
The Crown Prince of Liechtenstein made a State Visit to India on 27 October 2026. Consider the following countries:
1. Switzerland
2. Poland
3. Norway
4. Iceland
How many of the above are members of the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) along with Liechtenstein?
questions.why: EFTA has four members: Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. Poland is in the European Union. India signed a trade and economic partnership agreement with EFTA, so these visits matter for investment.
questions.insight: India signed a trade and economic partnership agreement with EFTA, so these visits matter for investment.

questions.subject: History
questions.q:
With reference to the Gollala Gudi temple declared a monument of national importance, consider the following statements:
1. It is located at Palampet village in Mulugu district, Telangana.
2. It is a Trikutalaya, a temple with three sanctums.
3. It is attributed broadly to the Kakatiya period of the 12th-13th century CE.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The declaration raised the number of ASI-protected monuments in Telangana to 10, and the Ramappa temple of the Kakatiya period is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.subject: History
questions.q:
With reference to the declaration of monuments of national importance in India, consider the following statements:
1. The ASI is under the Ministry of Tourism.
2. The legal framework is provided by the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958.
3. The Archaeological Survey of India functions under the Ministry of Culture.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The ASI is responsible for the conservation, maintenance and regulated public access to protected monuments, and it works under the Ministry of Culture.

questions.subject: History
questions.q:
With reference to Sri Aurobindo, whose 150th birth anniversary is being commemorated, consider the following statements:
1. He lived from 1872 to 1950.
2. A virtual museum on him was unveiled at Bharat Nivas in Auroville.
3. The museum was developed jointly by the Auroville Foundation, the Puducherry Government and the Ministry of Culture.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The museum uses digital touchpoints and an olfactory installation presenting the aromas of 12 flowers associated with Sri Aurobindo and The Mother.

questions.subject: History
questions.q:
With reference to the Chandni Chowk Town Hall in Delhi, consider the following statements:
1. It was built between 1860 and 1866.
2. It was built in the Mughal period by Shah Jahan.
3. It is a Grade-I heritage property to be redeveloped as a Global Heritage Centre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It dates to the British period and served as the Municipal Corporation's headquarters for over five decades until 2010. The MoU between the Delhi Government and the MCD plans adaptive reuse with museums and tourism facilities.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Thirukkural, consider the following statements:
1. It is traditionally attributed to the poet Ilango Adigal.
2. It has 1,330 couplets arranged in 133 chapters.
3. It is divided into the sections Aram, Porul and Inbam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It is traditionally attributed to Thiruvalluvar. Porul deals with worldly affairs and politics, and a Russian edition was presented by the Prime Minister to President Putin.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: In the Thirukkural, the section called 'Inbam' deals with which one of the following?
questions.why: Aram means virtue, Porul means worldly affairs including politics, wealth and society, and Inbam means love.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the Meenakshi Sundareswarar temple at Madurai, consider the following statements:
1. Its Maha Kumbabishekam was held in 2026 after 17 years.
2. It is an example of Dravidian architecture with gopurams and mandapams.
3. Its Veeravasantharaya Mandapam was damaged in a fire in 2018 and was restored.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The renovation covered 186 projects at a cost of Rs 32.29 crore, and the rebuilt mandapam uses 79 carved black granite pillars.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: Kumbabishekam, which was held at the Madurai Meenakshi temple, is a ceremony associated with which one of the following?
opts: Annual car festival of the temple deity
Offering of grains to the deity at the harvest
Recitation of the Vedas in the temple hall
questions.why: The water is poured over the temple's golden vimanas. The previous ceremony at this temple was in April 2009.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the BAPS Swaminarayan Hindu Mandir inaugurated near Paris, consider the following statements:
1. It is France's first traditionally designed stone Hindu temple.
2. It is the largest temple of its kind in mainland Europe.
3. Its stones were carved in France by local artisans without any inputs from India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The stones were hand-carved in India and combined with French engineering. The inauguration was part of a 13-day Festival of Culture and included a Jal Yatra on the Seine.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to Kumik, declared Ladakh's first Heritage Village, consider the following statements:
1. It is located in the Zanskar region.
2. Kumik has surplus water for irrigation.
3. It was recognised for its traditional architecture, Buddhist heritage and Kanjur manuscripts.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Kumik faces water scarcity, which has hurt irrigation and farming and led to migration. Kanjur, or Kangyur, refers to the Tibetan Buddhist canonical works of the Buddha's teachings.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: Adi Vaani, which was upgraded with five new tribal languages, is a platform of which one of the following?
opts: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
questions.why: It was upgraded at the National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums at Mysuru and now has an iOS app. The Tribot platform was also launched.
